text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day,
ahead of the Asahi Hai FS—
we paid a visit to someone in service to
the House of Roses.

text_block_list.name: Top Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Lady Rose's splendid performance in her
debut race was a source of great joy to
everyone in the clan, as well as to us.

text_block_list.name: Top Trainer
text_block_list.text: No—let us dispense with lengthy preambles.

text_block_list.name: Top Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"In order to claim your first GⅠ victory at
the Asahi Hai FS,
you wish to receive permission to use the
'Ibaramine Training Center'—
is that correct?"

color_text_info_list.Text: 茨峰トレーニングセンター

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following her debut race,
the person contacted in pursuit of her first
GⅠ victory was a top trainer who had served
the Rose Clan for many years.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
He served as a mentor to all trainer candidates
of the clan,
and I was no exception—
I had learned a great deal under his
tutelage.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The near-complete training facility he had
been helping develop
was the Ibaramine Training Center.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Modeled after a French training center,
the facility—
particularly its woodchip-surfaced uphill
course—
had become a major topic of discussion among
Trainers.

text_block_list.name: Top Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...I have served the Rose Clan for many long
years. With each passing year,
as if their feelings were compounding upon
one another,
the prowess of the clan's Umamusume has
steadily grown.

text_block_list.name: Top Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Which is why my expectations for the two of
you are especially high.
After all,
I was the one who recommended him to be your
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Top Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Which is why my expectations for the two of
you are especially high.
After all,
I was the one who recommended her to be your
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Top Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I believe in you with all my heart,
and I take pride in wishing for your success
more than anyone.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
You do me too much honor.
I am deeply humbled.

text_block_list.name: Top Trainer
text_block_list.text: —Even so, however.

text_block_list.name: Top Trainer
text_block_list.text:
It is still an incomplete training
facility.
Basic safety has been verified. However—

text_block_list.name: Top Trainer
text_block_list.text:
The efficacy of each facility remains
unverified. Therefore,
the user must possess the proficiency to
calculate the optimal workload for each
individual Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Top Trainer
text_block_list.text:
If you intend to use it immediately,
you must properly understand the
facility's
characteristics and make your judgment in
light of Lady Rose's current condition.

text_block_list.name: Top Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Therefore,
we must test whether your level of
understanding is truly worthy of putting it
to use.

text_block_list.name: Top Trainer
text_block_list.text:
One week from now,
I will administer a written exam.
It will test you in detail on the
characteristics and training benefits of
each facility under various hypothetical
scenarios.

text_block_list.name: Top Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Let us set the passing mark at ninety percent
correct.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I have taken the top trainers' written exams
alongside other trainers several times,
and they are notorious for their high
difficulty,
averaging around a sixty percent passing
score.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me for speaking out of turn,
but isn't that perhaps a bit too severe?
choice_data_list: No, that's a completely natural co...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rose Kingdom's safety is at stake.
Unless they overcome an appropriate
hurdle,
I cannot grant my permission.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so...
the days of intense study began.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Those few precious hours after finishing
training and daily chores.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Or perhaps those few hours in the morning,
before regular Trainer duties begin.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Furthermore, during our lunch break—

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Look at all those detailed notes...
Are you planning a new training menu?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There is much at the Ibaramine Training
Center that is not commonly seen in Japan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thus,
there was much to be learned.
What degree of strain would be placed on
which muscles if one were to utilize them—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We must run simulations and apply exercise
physiology and functional anatomy to find
the answer.
choice_data_list: There's so much to think about and...

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I see. Man,
she's really been going all out lately.
Working late into the night,
too... It's really impressive.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—...You look terribly pale.
Have you been sleeping properly?
choice_data_list: I haven't been pulling an all-nigh...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Until the exams are over,
feel free to switch your training entirely
to independent practice.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Right now,
you should devote all of your time
to the written exam.
choice_data_list: No, please let us proceed as usual.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There is not much time before the Asahi Hai
FS.
Every single day built up will eventually
decide victory or defeat.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
However, should you, my Trainer,
collapse from overwork...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...What is it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Please leave it to me," I added,
bowing my head.
I had no intention of letting this opportunity
slip away.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Understood.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I request our standard training routine
today as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After carrying out our usual training
duties,
she diligently studies for her upcoming
exams.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There were times when I collapsed asleep at
my desk,
but I read through every document I
needed to
and hammered it all into my head.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And then.

text_block_list.name: Top Trainer
text_block_list.text: Begin.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The written examination was administered at
the clan's manor.
True to a test personally drafted by elite
Trainers,
it was lined with questions that permitted
no simple answers.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Holding my aching head,
likely from lack of sleep,
I nonetheless kept my pen moving across the
page—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(The myriad facilities at the Baramine
Training Center,
none of which I had ever had the privilege
to experience before...)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(To fully grasp all of that and acquire the
breadth of knowledge
required to determine the optimal workload.
And within a single week, no less—)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(... Is that truly possible? No, yet
all I can do is believe in you.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (Stay strong, Trainer. Hold on...!)

text_block_list.name: Top Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting,
the scoring is complete.
As for the results—

text_block_list.name: Top Trainer
text_block_list.text: A perfect score.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Top Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I had faith in you, of course,
but to think you would achieve a perfect
score...

text_block_list.name: Top Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I shall request that a special usage permit
be issued.
Please make full use of it.

text_block_list.name: Top Trainer
text_block_list.text:
—One more thing. To you,
who challenge the curse alongside Lady
Rose,
allow me a word from one trainer to
another.

text_block_list.name: Top Trainer
text_block_list.text:
To see what our lady cannot and offer our
support—
that is the duty of those who serve her.

text_block_list.name: Top Trainer
text_block_list.text:
The weight Lady Rose carries is immense.
At times, she too may lose her way.

text_block_list.name: Top Trainer
text_block_list.text: You must become her third eye.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Upon returning home,
all the strength drained from my body.
Both physically and mentally,
I seemed to have been far more pushed to
the brink than I had realized.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By addressing my shortcomings at the Ibaramine
Training Center,
I can face the Asahi Hai FS.
This has surely brought me one step closer
to achieving my long-cherished dream—!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah, haah...!
TaaaaaaAAH—!!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to the gentle cushioning beneath my
feet,
I can push this body right to the brink of
its limits.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It is a precious opportunity you have secured
for me.
I shall hone myself to the utmost,
leaving nothing to waste.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Once again, thank you so very much.
choice_data_list: No, it's only natural as your Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
“I am glad that Rose Kingdom's Trainer
is you.”
